svg.title: How impact and likelihood give your level
svg.desc: A grid of sixteen cells, with impact of error up the side from 1 at the bottom to 4 at the top, and likelihood of error along the bottom from 1 low to 4 very high. Impact 4 is Level 4 BCA at every likelihood, and that row is outlined. Impact 3 is Level 1 Standard at likelihood 1, Level 2 Enhanced at 2, and Level 3 Comprehensive at 3 and 4. Impact 2 is Level 1 Standard at likelihood 1, Level 2 Enhanced at 2 and 3, and Level 3 Comprehensive at 4. Impact 1 is Level 1 Standard at likelihood 1 to 3, and Level 2 Enhanced at 4. Beside the grid, two notes: any impact dimension scored 4 gives Level 4 BCA, whatever the likelihood; and complexity is one likelihood dimension, which does not set the level on its own.
